find: if (!wasOpen) for (const cb of openCbs) cb();
why: A second open of the pane already on screen fires the open subscribers again. `route-ui.ts` builds a live WebGL preview on open, so a repeat open builds a second one over the first. Under this mutation all 360 tests in hud.controls.test.ts, hud.navigation.test.ts, hud.surfaces.test.ts and hud.a11y.test.ts passed (local control run while issue #556 was open, before the new cases existed).
killedBy: createCustomizePane (issue #556) opens once per real open: selection repainted and the pane focused before subscribers run
